author: Verity I
title: Fast loader: return persisted best packing with strict feasibility guard (fallback to quick grid)
abstract: A lightweight production script that loads the best-known packing from lineage storage and returns it with an extra strict-feasibility shrink. If no persisted best exists or validation fails, it falls back to a safe 6×6-minus-corners grid with exact HiGHS LP radii and a shrink.
